steps.text: 12 Level cards facedown in ascending order, level 1 on top
Shuffle the 50 Number cards facedown in the center
{n} Lives faceup near the edge of the play area
Randomly appoint a Seer (stays Seer until the level is completed, then passes clockwise)
The Seer reveals the top Level card and draws that many Number cards, looks at the allowed number and writes the allowed hints on the Hint sheet
steps.note: Level 1: draw 4, look at 3, write 1 number

steps.text: The Seer shuffles those cards and deals them out from their left, including themself
Everyone ready places a palm on the table; when all are, lift hands and the level starts
